about: Motion techniques for product demo and launch videos. A card is a hypothesis about what helps a viewer understand, not a proven effect. `prai.status`: supported = one PRAI block/field does it; combo = a combination of existing blocks; custom = needs new code. Built with Codex (review round 2) from the croScan promo work and general motion-design practice.

techniques.name: Beat landing
techniques.what: The key element's motion finishes exactly on a beat, then settles.
techniques.why: The ear predicts the beat; a pose that lands with it feels intentional and easy to follow.
techniques.use_when: the one important action or claim of a moment
techniques.avoid_when: everything at once — when all things bounce, nothing is accented

techniques.name: Word-by-word cut
techniques.what: A short line appears one chunk per beat ("Merge.|Click.|Ship.").
techniques.why: Chunks sized to the beat are read at the music's pace.
techniques.use_when: slogans, the problem statement, an outro
techniques.avoid_when: full sentences that must be read as one thought

techniques.name: Off-beat anticipation
techniques.what: A small secondary motion on the "and" before a strong beat.
techniques.why: It sets up the next downbeat so the main hit feels bigger.
techniques.use_when: before a reveal or a logo
techniques.avoid_when: busy scenes: it reads as noise

techniques.name: Hold for reading
techniques.what: After landing, nothing moves until the viewer has read it.
techniques.why: Reading needs stillness; motion steals attention from text.
techniques.avoid_when: pure brand moments with no text
techniques.prai: camera rests ≥ 1 beat (checked by `prai check`); until/auto lengths

techniques.name: Hard cut on the beat
techniques.what: The next scene replaces the last one on a beat, with a 3% punch-in.
techniques.why: Clean, fast, and the music carries the change.
techniques.avoid_when: you need to show spatial continuity

techniques.name: Shape wipe
techniques.what: A circle grows from a point and covers the frame with the next background.
techniques.why: Marks a chapter; the origin point can carry meaning (e.g. from a button).
techniques.use_when: entering a brand moment or the outro
techniques.avoid_when: more than twice per video: it becomes a cliché

techniques.name: UI state swap
techniques.what: The screenshot changes to the next state right after the click that causes it.
techniques.why: Shows cause → effect without screen recording.
techniques.avoid_when: hiding steps the product really needs (overclaiming speed)
techniques.prai: demo swaps (fade 0 = cut on the beat)

techniques.name: Match cut
techniques.what: A shape or position in one scene continues as the same shape in the next (a card becomes the app window).
techniques.why: Connects an idea to the real UI in one glance.
techniques.use_when: from concept (intro) to the first demo screen
techniques.avoid_when: the link is forced
techniques.prai: screen block at the end of an intro + a demo scene starting at full

techniques.name: Phrase build-up
techniques.what: Words stack up into a phrase, one per beat, and stay.
techniques.why: Each new word adds meaning while the earlier ones remain readable.
techniques.avoid_when: long phrases that overflow the frame

techniques.name: Giant outline type
techniques.what: Huge outlined words behind the content, stepping one notch per beat.
techniques.why: Adds rhythm and a verbal texture without competing with the message.
techniques.avoid_when: as body text

techniques.name: Typing shown large
techniques.what: A long input is shown in a big card while it is typed.
techniques.why: Real input boxes are too small to read in a video.
techniques.avoid_when: it implies the product types for you when it does not

techniques.name: Mask reveal
techniques.what: Text slides up from behind an invisible edge.
techniques.why: A tidy, premium entrance for headlines.
techniques.avoid_when: as pure decoration

techniques.name: Overview → detail zoom
techniques.what: Show the whole screen first, then zoom to the control or result.
techniques.why: The viewer knows where they are before seeing the detail.
techniques.avoid_when: zooming beyond the capture's resolution (soft text)
techniques.prai: demo camera (log zoom, lands on the beat)

techniques.name: Pan between related parts
techniques.what: The camera travels from the input to its result.
techniques.why: Draws the line between cause and effect.
techniques.avoid_when: while text must be read

techniques.name: Detail → overview
techniques.what: After the detail, pull back to the whole screen.
techniques.why: Restores context before the next step.
techniques.avoid_when: every few beats (ping-pong)

techniques.name: Magnifier inset
techniques.what: A magnified window over the full screen.
techniques.why: Detail and context at the same time.
techniques.use_when: a small change in a big screen
techniques.avoid_when: already crowded frames

techniques.name: Box / underline
techniques.what: A coloured box or underline pops onto the element, with a short label.
techniques.why: Names exactly what to look at.
techniques.avoid_when: more than two at once
techniques.prai: demo marks (box | underline, auto label side)

techniques.name: Spotlight
techniques.what: Everything but the target dims.
techniques.why: Cuts through busy screens.
techniques.avoid_when: the context around the target matters

techniques.name: Cursor + click ripple
techniques.what: One cursor travels between clicks and touches down on the beat with a ring.
techniques.why: Makes the user's action — and its cause — visible.
techniques.use_when: any click that changes the screen
techniques.avoid_when: the ring could be mistaken for a real UI effect

techniques.name: Count-up to a number
techniques.what: A number rolls and stops on a beat.
techniques.why: The stop gives the number weight.
techniques.avoid_when: the number is not true or not sourced

techniques.name: Feature chips
techniques.what: Short glossy pills name categories or features.
techniques.why: Summarises scope in one glance.
techniques.avoid_when: more than ~4 (a menu, not a message)

techniques.name: Card fan
techniques.what: A small stack of document cards fans out.
techniques.why: Shows there are many items without listing them.
techniques.avoid_when: the cards' content must be read

techniques.name: Before / after split
techniques.what: Two states side by side under the same conditions.
techniques.why: The difference is the message.
techniques.avoid_when: conditions differ (unfair comparison)

techniques.name: Connector path
techniques.what: A line draws from cause to effect.
techniques.why: Explains a flow of data or work.
techniques.avoid_when: it turns into a diagram nobody can read

techniques.name: Semantic colour
techniques.what: Warn / danger / ok colours tie marks to states.
techniques.why: Colour + label reads faster than label alone.
techniques.avoid_when: colour is the only signal (accessibility)

techniques.name: Palette per section
techniques.what: Problem on one background, solution on another.
techniques.why: The switch itself says "now it gets better".
techniques.avoid_when: it breaks the brand

techniques.name: Mono → colour
techniques.what: The selected thing gains colour while the rest stays grey.
techniques.why: Discovery / activation in one move.
techniques.avoid_when: it misrepresents the product's real colours

techniques.name: Glossy depth cues
techniques.what: Soft highlights and shadows make pills and orbs feel tactile.
techniques.why: Warmth and polish without 3D.
techniques.avoid_when: it has nothing to do with the product

techniques.name: Action foley
techniques.what: A short click or whoosh on an action.
techniques.why: Sound confirms the action happened.
techniques.avoid_when: on every move (fatigue)

techniques.name: Music ducks under voice
techniques.what: The music dips while someone speaks.
techniques.why: Speech stays intelligible; energy returns in gaps.

techniques.name: Silence before impact
techniques.what: A beat of near-silence, then the reveal.
techniques.why: Contrast makes the reveal land.
techniques.avoid_when: more than once; jump scares

techniques.name: Sound leads the cut
techniques.what: The next scene's sound starts a little before its picture.
techniques.why: Smooths the cut and pulls the viewer forward.
techniques.avoid_when: sound and picture disagree
techniques.prai: sfx at a negative-feeling beat at the end of the previous scene

techniques.name: Problem → action → result
techniques.what: Say the pain, show the action in the product, show the result.
techniques.why: Explains why the feature exists, not just that it does.
techniques.use_when: the body of a service intro
techniques.avoid_when: the problem or result is made up

techniques.name: Timeline overlap
techniques.what: Two bars on a time axis grow; their overlap is framed.
techniques.why: Turns a scheduling conflict into space you can see.
techniques.avoid_when: the axis or durations are distorted

techniques.name: Product material → logo
techniques.what: A shape from the product (a bar, a card, a cursor) turns into the logo.
techniques.why: A signature: the brand is built from what the product does.
techniques.avoid_when: the link is forced, or it copies a reference's design
techniques.prai: approximate with logo rings + wipe; true shape morphing is custom

techniques.name: Result → call to action
techniques.what: After the benefit, one clear next step (URL, command, store link).
techniques.why: Gives the interest somewhere to go.
techniques.avoid_when: it disappears before it can be read

techniques.name: Groove layer
techniques.what: Background orbs bounce and the backdrop pulses on the beat, weighted by bar position and loudness.
techniques.why: Keeps the frame breathing between the main cues without stealing focus.
techniques.avoid_when: demo scenes (it fights the UI)

techniques.name: Card becomes the screen
techniques.what: At the end of the intro the product screen grows from small into the frame, and the first demo continues from it.
techniques.why: The intro's promise turns into the product without a hard break.
techniques.avoid_when: the first demo starts zoomed in (the match breaks)
techniques.prai: screen block on the intro's last beats
